newsitem.title: CANADA: Intensity reviewing options to bid.
newsitem.headline: Intensity reviewing options to bid.

text.p: Intensity Resources Ltd said on Friday it received Renata Resources Inc's takeover offer documents and was seeking alternatives to the bid.
Intensity said it hired Scotia Capital Markets as financial adviser and was urging shareholders to wait before reacting to the Renata bid.
Junior oil firm Renata on February 27 announced its intention to launch the C$110 million bid, offering C$2.25 cash or 1.875 of a Renata share for each Intensity share.

"Our primary concern is to serve the best interests of our shareholders. Toward that end, we will review all of the options available to us in forming a recommendation to our shareholders in this matter," Intensity chief executive Gary Freeman said in a statement.
Renata is headed by John Gunn, the former chief executive of Ballistic Energy, which was absorbed by Stampeder Exploration Ltd last year.
Under the offer, Renata would assume about C$30 million in Intensity long-term debt.
